run.title: Product Research
assumptions: Product costs are estimates: supplier prices are starting prices before shipping
Ad counts only include ads that use the exact product words, so real numbers can be higher
Green on a map means we found nobody else selling this exact item there, not that nobody does
Lash adhesive is a cosmetic used near the eye: selling in the EU or UK needs a safety assessment and product registration

headline: No clear yes yet, but the peptide body oil is the best lead: one brand has advertised it alone for four months, it is white-label so you can source it, and Germany shows no copies so far.

products.name: Waterproof Fleece Chair Blanket (The Chair Blanket)
products.category: Outdoor / home: fleece chair cover blanket
products.one_liner: A proven US hit (Shark Tank, Lowe's, Target, 500+ ads, about US$3,000-4,800 a day per Minea) that has not reached European shops: in Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, France and Italy only supplier copies were found.
why: Proven: City Bonfires runs 97-144 active ads and 500+ in total; Minea estimates US$3,000-4,800 revenue a day
No European shop found selling it; EU Amazon shows only garden-furniture covers and wheelchair blankets
Alibaba and AliExpress list copies ("camping chair cover", "chair blanket"), so it can be sourced
products.risk: No ready-made supplier: you would need a factory (minimum order, samples, upfront cash), and it is bulky to ship.
next: Ask 3 Alibaba blanket factories (wheelchair/stadium blanket makers) for price, MOQ and a sample
Only test if a sample under ~€15 with MOQ 50-100 is possible; target NL/DE/BE
products.best_region: Netherlands, Germany and Belgium: big terrace and fire-pit culture, and no seller found.

snapshot.icp: Homeowners 30-65 with a fire pit or terrace; parents at kids' sports
snapshot.job: Stay warm and dry in an outdoor chair
snapshot.cogs: No ready-made supplier found (AliExpress, Minea); needs a factory to make it. Similar waterproof fleece blankets are €15-30 on AliExpress
snapshot.claims: Waterproof, windproof, fits most chairs, packs into a bag
snapshot.demoable: Yes: cold wet chair to cosy seat in 10 seconds

gates.name: Chain gate
gates.why: In the US Lowe's, Target and Walmart sell it; no European chain found

gates.name: Copies gate
gates.why: In Europe only supplier copies (Alibaba, AliExpress) found

gates.name: Swarm gate
gates.why: One brand (City Bonfires) runs nearly all ads

gates.name: Bulk gate
gates.why: Fleece with a waterproof back is bulky; shipping costs more than a gadget

gates.name: Regulated gate
gates.why: Textile label needed; check the brand's patent or design rights first

angles: Fire pit and terrace evenings (the Dutch and German "vuurkorf"/"Feuerschale" culture)
Football and hockey parents on cold stands
Camping and festival chairs
Christmas gift for dad
TAKEN: "As seen on Shark Tank" (City Bonfires)

compare.note: The same red buffalo-check fleece cover with waterproof back appears on AliExpress and Alibaba listings.

products.advertiser_takeaway: City Bonfires dominates with 97-144 active ads and 500+ in total since 2024, which is strong proof the ads pay in the US and Canada. No European seller showed up.

products.name: Multi-Peptide Body Oil (NØRD BODY)
products.category: Body care: firming and anti-cellulite oil
products.store_products: 16 products, mostly this oil at test prices
products.one_liner: One young brand has advertised this alone for four months, and it is a white-label oil anyone can buy. Copies already sit in Amazon's top results in four countries, but not in Germany.
why: NØRD BODY runs 199 of the 202 ads for "peptide body oil", live since 8 June, about 50 new ads a month
It is a white-label oil: the same bottle and box are on AliExpress without the brand, so you can source it
Germany is clear so far; the UK has it at £11.99 (Amazon result 1) and the US at US$27.80
products.risk: A white-label product can be copied by anyone overnight, and EU cosmetics rules apply before the first sale.
next: Ask the AliExpress supplier whether the oil comes with EU cosmetic safety paperwork (a CPSR) and registration
If yes, test in Germany with German ads: 3 short massage videos, about €20 a day for 5 days
products.best_region: Germany: no copy found by photo or in the top shopper results, and the proof (four months of ads) comes from Australia.

snapshot.icp: Women 30-55 who want firmer-looking legs, bum and arms
snapshot.job: Smooth crepey skin and the look of cellulite with a daily massage
snapshot.cogs: About €5-8 landed from a white-label supplier (estimate, not checked)
snapshot.claims: Triple peptide complex, caffeine, CoQ10; fast-absorbing, non-greasy
snapshot.demoable: Yes: massage ritual and skin-glow close-ups

gates.name: Chain gate
gates.why: No chain sells this exact bottle; chains sell other body oils such as Bio-Oil

gates.name: Copies gate
gates.why: Cheaper copies in Amazon's top results in Australia, the US, the UK and New Zealand; none found in Germany

gates.name: Swarm gate
gates.why: One brand runs 99% of the ads

gates.name: Bulk gate
gates.why: A 240 ml bottle: light, but a liquid

gates.name: Regulated gate
gates.why: A cosmetic with cellulite and firming claims: EU safety report and registration needed

angles: German-language version for Germany and Austria
Post-pregnancy body care for new mums (check ingredient safety)
Gym and sports: post-workout massage oil
Bundle with a dry brush or massage roller
TAKEN: "For bums, tums, thighs and underarms" (NØRD BODY's main message)

compare.note: The same amber pump bottle and box, sold without the brand name on AliExpress and by many sellers on Amazon.

products.advertiser_takeaway: NØRD BODY is alone: 199 of the 202 ads are theirs, running steadily since June. Four months of spending is good proof the ads pay. The only other advertisers (Coco & Eve and two small shops) ran one ad each.

category_notes.ca: The photo search returned no results in Canada.
category_notes.de: dm and Douglas sell other body oils; this exact bottle was not found in Germany.

products.name: Under-Eye CC Cream Compact (DermoCosmetic)
products.store_products: 2 products: this compact and a brush
products.one_liner: One Italian shop has advertised this alone for six months, which is strong proof. But it copies Tarte's best-seller, which Sephora and Ulta sell, and look-alikes cost £6 on Amazon UK.
why: DermoCosmetic runs all 61 Italian ads for "correttore occhiaie" and its oldest has run since 30 March
It is a look-alike of Tarte's Colored Clay CC Undereye Corrector, sold by Sephora, Ulta, Kohl's and Macy's at US$32
Look-alikes are easy to find: £5.99 on Amazon UK and on Temu in Australia
products.risk: Copying a famous brand's look invites ad takedowns, and EU cosmetics need a safety report and registration before the first sale.
next: Get a quote for an EU cosmetic safety report and registration from a Responsible Person service
If it is affordable, test a market DermoCosmetic is not in (Spain or Portugal) with your own branding
products.best_region: None of the six. The proof is in Italy, which these checks do not cover; Spain or Portugal would copy that playbook.

snapshot.claims: High coverage, does not crease after 8 hours, 3 shades, built-in mirror
snapshot.demoable: Yes: before and after under one eye is instant and visual

gates.name: Chain gate
gates.why: Ulta, Sephora and Kohl's sell Tarte's original in the US; Walmart Canada lists a look-alike at CA$18

gates.name: Copies gate
gates.why: Look-alikes from £5.99 on Amazon UK and on Temu; Italy and Spain were not checked

gates.name: Swarm gate
gates.why: One brand owns the Italian ads

gates.name: Bulk gate
gates.why: Small and light

gates.name: Regulated gate
gates.why: A cosmetic: the EU needs a Responsible Person, a safety report and registration before selling

angles: Spanish or Portuguese version of the same before-and-after ads
Men's under-eye concealer: tired eyes after work
New mums: hide sleepless nights in 30 seconds

compare.note: The same rose-gold square compact with a mirror: Tarte's original, and many look-alikes.

products.advertiser_takeaway: In Italy DermoCosmetic is alone: all 61 ads for "correttore occhiaie" are theirs, the oldest from 30 March, and 23 started this month. Six months of spend means it pays. The ads are Italian, so this proves Italy, not the six countries on the map.

category_notes.us: Sephora and Ulta sell many CC creams; the exact compact is Tarte's original.
category_notes.de: dm and Douglas sell other CC creams (tubes and sticks), not this compact. The photo search returned no results in Germany.

products.name: Magnetic Tennis Swing Trainer (SwngPro)
products.ad_days: Oldest live ad 2026-09-03 (101 ads on 16 Oct)
products.one_liner: Only one brand advertises it and the margin is huge, but identical copies already sit in Amazon's top results in every country, from about US$30. Worth watching, not testing yet.
why: Swng runs 60+ ads and is ramping fast (36 started in October), with almost no other advertisers
A supplier sells it from about US$8, so roughly 90% of the US$89 price is left for ads and profit
But copies are easy to find: Amazon US result 3 at US$29.99, UK result 2 at £17, Germany result 1 at €45.99
products.risk: Swng's ads are only six weeks old, so they are not yet proof it pays, and Amazon copies undercut US$89 by two thirds.
next: Re-check Swng's ads in early December: 101 ads now, all since 3 September
If they are still running, test in the Netherlands and Belgium with Dutch ads, also aimed at padel players
products.best_region: Netherlands or Belgium (re-checked 16 Oct): no magnetic snap trainer in Amazon's top 20 there. Germany, Austria, France, Italy, the UK and Ireland have copies from €7-20.

snapshot.demoable: Yes: the snap sound on a good swing is made for short video

gates.name: Chain gate
gates.why: Walmart Canada lists the same stick at CA$23 (it may be a marketplace seller). No chain found elsewhere

gates.name: Copies gate
gates.why: Cheaper copies sit in Amazon's top 5 in every country, from £17 in the UK and €13 in Germany

gates.name: Swarm gate

gates.name: Bulk gate
gates.why: Small and light

gates.name: Regulated gate
gates.why: No health claims needed

Pickleball players in the US
Junior players: parents buying practice between lessons
Coaches and clubs: a set for group drills

products.name: Pre-Glued Lash Starter Kit (Lola's Lashes)
products.store_products: 250 products, all lashes and lash care
products.one_liner: Nobody else sells this exact kit, so the map is green. But the category is full: big brands in every chain, 28+ advertisers and Amazon kits with thousands of reviews.
why: Ardell, KISS imPRESS and GLAM pre-glued clusters sit in Target, Walmart, Kmart, Priceline and Chemist Warehouse from about US$12
At least 28 brands advertise "pre-glued lashes"; Lola's alone runs 147 of 250 ads and has advertised since February
Amazon is heavy: 10,550+ bought last month in the US, and the top listing in Canada has 25,100 reviews
products.risk: You would need your own lash brand, safety paperwork and creative good enough to beat established beauty brands on cost per sale.
next: Skip this as a product test. If beauty appeals, look for a lash-care add-on (remover, storage, aftercare) with fewer advertisers
products.best_region: None. The map is green only because no one copies Lola's design; rival pre-glued kits are in big chains in all six countries.

snapshot.claims: 5-10 day hold, waterproof, patented stick-and-clamp applicator, vegan; Beauty Awards 2025 shortlist
snapshot.demoable: Yes: before and after, three-step application on camera

gates.name: Chain gate
gates.why: No chain sells a copy of this exact kit, but Superdrug and Boots stock Lola's own kit, and every chain sells rival pre-glued clusters

gates.name: Copies gate
gates.why: No other seller copies this exact design. The rival kits look clearly different, so this gate passes, but the category is full

gates.name: Swarm gate
gates.why: Crowded, not a swarm: 12 of 28 brands are new in the last two months, and the biggest shops are all over a year old

gates.name: Bulk gate
gates.why: Small and light

gates.name: Regulated gate
gates.why: A cosmetic with adhesive used near the eye: needs EU/UK cosmetic safety assessment and registration before selling

products.name: Neck Firming Cream (Mudganics)
products.store_products: 42 products, Australian skincare, also sold wholesale
products.one_liner: The map is green only because this is Mudganics' own formula. Neck creams are a swarm: 40 advertisers, 38 new in two months, and 431,000+ bought on Amazon US last month.
why: 40 brands advertise "neck firming cream" and 38 of them started in the last two months: a swarm
Amazon is enormous: 431,550+ bought last month in the US, top listings with 19,000-37,900 reviews

next: Skip it. Demand is real, but sellers are flooding in faster than it grows
products.best_region: None. Chains such as Kmart, Walmart, John Lewis and Douglas sell neck creams in every country checked.

gates.name: Copies gate

gates.name: Swarm gate
gates.why: 40 brands advertise, 38 of them new in the last two months

gates.name: Bulk gate
gates.why: Small and light

gates.name: Regulated gate
gates.why: A cosmetic with firming claims: needs safety paperwork and proof for the claims

angles: Men's neck and jawline cream
"Tech neck" for under-40s who look down at phones all day
Post-weight-loss loose skin

Same.head: Own formula

products.name: No-Rinse Foam Paw Cleanser (Dandylion)
products.one_liner: Dandylion is an established brand already in Target, Chewy and Petco, and the same foam-and-brush bottle sells from about US$6 under dozens of names. Too cheap and too crowded for a newcomer.

next: Skip it. If pet care appeals, look for a higher-priced pet product with fewer sellers

products.name: Braided Dog Chew Ring (The Mellow Dog)
